name: Shimasaki Mai
source:
New young security guard brought on by deputy president. Is  hard working and honest. Is very naive expecting best out of everyone even when intentions seem clearly bad. 

[spoiler] Is an aspiring actress that gets help from protag. Has a crush on Yumi and with indirect help of protag is able to speak her mind. Due to training with protag however eventual turns her into pervert. [spoiler]
